questions.question:
Identify the correct sentence that uses inversion to emphasize the adverbial phrase.

Options:
options: Only after the rain had stopped did they begin the journey.
Only after the rain had stopped did they begin the journey.
Only after the rain had stopped did they begin the journey.
Only after the rain had stopped did they begin the journey.
questions.answer: Only after the rain had stopped did they begin the journey.

questions.question:
Which sentence correctly uses a cleft sentence to highlight the specific detail?

Options:
options: It was John who broke the window yesterday.
It was John who broke the window yesterday.
It was John who broke the window yesterday.
It was John who broke the window yesterday.
questions.answer: It was John who broke the window yesterday.

questions.question:
Select the correct form of the subjunctive in the following sentence.

If I were you, I _____ that advice.

Options:
options: would have taken
would have taken
would have taken
would have taken

questions.question:
Choose the option that correctly completes the sentence with ellipsis.

She said she would call, but I _____.

Options:
options: she didn't
she didn't
she didn't
she didn't

questions.question:
Which sentence demonstrates the correct use of a formal register in academic writing?

Options:
options: It is recommended that further research be conducted on this topic.
It is recommended that further research be conducted on this topic.
It is recommended that further research be conducted on this topic.
It is recommended that further research be conducted on this topic.
questions.answer: It is recommended that further research be conducted on this topic.
